notes: (p)IMD on-chain prediction market, Ethereum mainnet, built from SPEC.md. LaunchToken (src/LaunchToken.sol) is the fixed-supply pIMD ERC-20 with no constructor arguments; the factory mints and splits its supply. Five application contracts in SPEC.md section 2 deploy order, every argument address-typed and every constructor nonpayable with no external calls. PimdRegistry(assetAdmin): the asset admin is the admin wallet SPEC.md names, 0x8ad18e99f4c8d8406f9ba8899cf308000518a981; it adds asset versions and periods and may hand its role on; version 1 (IMD) and periods 0-3 are set in the constructor. BoundaryOracle(registry, verifier): the registry just deployed and the fixed mainnet BoundaryProofVerifier 0xa19a97b522cb379c2fb846a4b18589775f674ee9 (stored, not called, at construction). PimdAbove(registry, oracle, admin, owner): the admin wallet creates markets and sets rates within SPEC.md caps; $owner, the launch's owner, is credited every market fee and has no other power. StartOracle(registry, oracle): start prices requested 27 h or later via the IMD oracle INTAKE. PimdSwap2(registry): exact-output swaps along a version's path. PimdMarkets2 (SPEC.md section 6) is not in the accepted tree at this commit (see ADAPTATION.md and README Known limitations), so it is not listed here; a later build that adds it must extend this manifest. No contract receives any of the token supply at launch. Pool: pIMD paired with IMD at the launch policy's values; the deployer derives the opening price from the 2,500 IMD opening market cap.
